use: historical reference and offline analysis; not formal comparison

data.scope: Filtered operator measurements and short-output diagnosis. Full current-source phase, operator, capacity, service, and Python GPU recollection are pending.

implementation.accumulator: Two independent TMEM loads before one aligned wait. Per-output ascending K-group scale and FP32 FMA order stays equal.
implementation.epilogue: Identity FP32-to-BF16 round-to-nearest-even. C type remains BF16. Other shapes keep previous dispatch.

selected_operators.protocol: Complete static maximum-shape operations; three independent warm rounds, twenty alternating-order pairs/round,100 graph repetitions/sample. External timing events inside each graph exclude host submission gaps. No profiler during timing. Fixtures use immutable sources and repeatable destinations. DSpark append shares one cache after independent-cache verification. Stateless Q/K timing uses matching output-address sequences in one graph pool after independent verification; whole functions keep their output allocations. Other mutable destinations remain isolated. Before timing, compare both backends' returns and written cache/state slots at existing tolerances.

retained context KV append using the original generic frozen append
dspark_supplemental.lineage: Original generic RMS/decode algorithms adapted for the distinct DSpark semantics; the original eight frozen files remain byte-identical.
dspark_supplemental.numerical_golden: Independent FP64 PyTorch references in oh_my_vllm.ir.dspark; supplemental TileLang is the performance comparator.
